blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Amyloid positron emission tomography (PET) quantifies brain amyloid-$β$ as a standardized uptake value ratio (SUVR), but is costly and not widely available. Structural magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is routine, and plasma biomarkers such as phosphorylated tau 217 (p-tau217) are becoming practical. Synthesizing amyloid PET from MRI alone is ill-posed, because brain anatomy reveals little about amyloid burden. We present SUPRA (SUVR prior-guided amyloid synthesis), which divides this task between MRI and plasma biomarkers. A regression maps the plasma panel to regional SUVR levels, painted onto the subject's MRI segmentation as an explicit prior. A 3D network then adds a residual correction guided by MRI. The output is in absolute SUVR, and the model also runs on p-tau217 alone. On the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) cohort (111 test pairs), SUPRA reaches a peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) of 23.4 dB, against at most 20.7 dB for four published models, and rank correlations of 0.56 to 0.67 with true SUVR in the composite cortex, an early-accumulation region and the striatum, against at most 0.24. In a second, cognitively unimpaired cohort with other plasma platforms (143 test pairs), it reaches 22.8 dB and 0.32 to 0.61, against at most 21.4 dB and 0.20. Its area under the curve for amyloid positivity is 0.91 and 0.82, against at most 0.63. Ablations show that plasma supplies the amyloid information and the network the image quality. Combining MRI with a blood test yields synthetic amyloid PET that is realistic and tracks burden across regions.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Amyloid positron emission tomography (PET) is the reference method for measuring amyloid- β \beta (A β \beta ) in the living brain ( Clark et al., 2011 ; Klunk et al., 2004 ) , usually quantified as the standardized uptake value ratio (SUVR). Together with cerebrospinal fluid testing, it is used to confirm
amyloid pathology before anti-amyloid treatment and to select participants for
prevention trials ( van Dyck et al., 2023 ; Sperling et al., 2014 ) . However, amyloid PET is expensive, exposes patients to
radiation, and is not available in many hospitals ( Hansson et al., 2023 ) . Structural magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), in contrast, is part of routine clinical care. Blood tests are also becoming practical:
plasma phosphorylated tau 217 (p-tau217) now identifies amyloid-positive individuals with good
accuracy ( Palmqvist et al., 2020 ; Barthélemy et al., 2024 ) . Yet a blood test cannot show where in the brain amyloid has
accumulated. If an amyloid PET image could be synthesized from an MRI scan and a
blood sample, this regional information would become available far more widely.

blocks.en:
Synthesizing amyloid PET from MRI alone is an ill-posed problem. Amyloid builds up
years before brain atrophy appears, and the two are only loosely
related ( Jack et al., 2013 ) . Two brains with very similar anatomy can therefore carry very
different amounts of amyloid ( Jansen et al., 2015 ) . A network trained only on MRI tends to
predict the average uptake of its training cohort. Our evaluation on the Alzheimer’s Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) cohort shows that
published synthesis models do not yet solve this problem. We tested four of them,
three using MRI only and one also using plasma ( Li et al., 2024 ; Sargood et al., 2026 ; Ou et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) . All four barely track
the true cortical amyloid burden, and they separate amyloid-positive from
amyloid-negative subjects poorly.

blocks.en:
Our method, SUPRA (SUVR prior-guided amyloid synthesis), is based on a simple
division of labor. The blood test indicates how
much amyloid a person carries. The MRI shows the individual brain anatomy on which
this amyloid must be placed. Following this idea, we first turn the plasma panel
into an image. A regional regression predicts the mean SUVR of each brain structure
from the plasma markers, and these values are painted onto the subject’s own brain
segmentation. The result is a subject-specific SUVR prior: a coarse amyloid PET image that has the predicted level of each brain structure but no subject-specific detail. Its regression
coefficients and its regional levels can be inspected directly, so the blood-based
prediction is explicit.

blocks.en:
We evaluate the method on ADNI and on a second cohort, A4/LEARN, which combines the Anti-Amyloid Treatment in Asymptomatic Alzheimer’s (A4) study and the Longitudinal Evaluation of Amyloid Risk and Neurodegeneration (LEARN) study. This cohort differs from ADNI in two ways: its participants were cognitively unimpaired
at enrollment, and its plasma markers were measured on different assay platforms. On
ADNI, SUPRA reaches a peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) of 23.4 dB, a rank correlation of 0.67 with the true cortical burden and an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.91 for amyloid positivity, compared with at most 20.7 dB, 0.23 and 0.63 for the published models. It also outperforms all four on A4/LEARN. In three regions from the amyloid literature (the composite cortex behind the official amyloid status, an early-accumulation region and the striatum), its rank correlations are 0.64, 0.67 and 0.56 on ADNI and 0.59, 0.61 and 0.32 on A4/LEARN, against at most 0.24 and 0.20 for the published models. Unlike a single blood value, the synthesized scan thus gives an estimate for each of these regions.

blocks.en:
Ablation experiments support the division of labor behind the design. Without
plasma, the synthesized images look almost as good, but they lose most of their
amyloid information: the cortical correlation falls from 0.67 to 0.21 on ADNI. The
refinement network raises image quality by about 8 dB in PSNR over the prior alone,
and most of this gain remains when the network receives no MRI input. The subject’s
anatomy, carried by the prior, thus shapes the image, while the MRI intensities add a smaller refinement. The method brings image quality and regional amyloid information together in one scan.

blocks.en:
The main contributions of this work are: • SUPRA, a method for amyloid PET synthesis from MRI and plasma. It turns plasma biomarkers
into an explicit regional SUVR prior and refines this prior with an
anatomy-guided residual network. The output is in absolute SUVR units. • An evaluation of image quality, amyloid positivity and regional amyloid burden, including regions affected early and late in the disease, on two cohorts that differ in population and assay platform. • Ablation experiments that separate the roles of the plasma panel, the MRI

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Deep generative models have been widely used to translate one medical imaging
modality into another ( Dayarathna et al., 2024 ) . Early work on MRI-to-PET synthesis used
convolutional networks and generative adversarial networks, including paired and
unpaired (CycleGAN-style) training ( Isola et al., 2017 ; Zhu et al., 2017 ; Sikka et al., 2018 ; Pan et al., 2018 ) . More recent methods use diffusion
models, either in image space or in the latent space of an autoencoder ( Ho et al., 2020 ; Rombach et al., 2022 ) .
PASTA, CoCoLIT and IL-CLDM belong to this group and are among our comparison
methods ( Li et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Sargood et al., 2026 ; Ou et al., 2025 ) . Most of these methods were developed for fluorodeoxyglucose (FDG) or amyloid PET and
were evaluated mainly with image-similarity metrics such as PSNR and the structural similarity index (SSIM) ( Dayarathna et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2004 ) . For amyloid PET, these metrics say little about whether the
synthesized scan carries the correct amyloid burden. We therefore also evaluate
regional burden and amyloid positivity.

Plasma assays of A β \beta 42/40, phosphorylated tau and markers of
neurodegeneration and astrocytic activation, such as neurofilament light chain (NfL) and glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP), are now
available on several platforms ( Janelidze et al., 2021 ; Hansson et al., 2023 ) . Among them, plasma p-tau217 shows the strongest agreement with amyloid PET ( Janelidze et al., 2023 ; Ashton et al., 2024 ; Palmqvist et al., 2025 ) , and several p-tau217-based blood tests have recently been cleared by the US Food and Drug Administration for patients with cognitive symptoms ( U.S. Food and Drug Administration, 2025 ; C2N Diagnostics, 2026 ; Roche Diagnostics, 2026 ) .
However, assay values differ between platforms, and cut-offs fitted on one platform
do not transfer directly to another ( Janelidze et al., 2021 ; Hansson et al., 2023 ) . In practice, the available panel
also differs between studies and clinics. A method that uses plasma should
therefore handle missing assays and should be validated on more than one cohort and
platform. We address both points: the model accepts any subset of assays, and we
evaluate it on a second cohort with different assay platforms.

blocks.en: 3 Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 概览

blocks.en:
Our goal is to synthesize an amyloid PET image, in absolute SUVR units, from a
structural MRI scan and a panel of plasma biomarkers. The method gives each input a
clear role. The plasma panel indicates how much amyloid a person carries,
and the MRI provides the anatomy on which this amyloid is placed. SUPRA has two
stages (Fig. 1 ). First, the plasma panel is turned into a
subject-specific SUVR prior: a coarse PET-like image whose regional levels are
predicted from the blood values (Section 3.2 ). Second, a 3D network
refines this prior under the guidance of the subject’s anatomy
(Section 3.3 ). The network predicts only a correction, and the final
image is the prior plus this correction.

blocks.en: 4.1 Cohorts

blocks.en:
The development cohort comes from the Alzheimer’s Disease Neuroimaging Initiative
(ADNI) ( Petersen et al., 2010 ; Jack et al., 2008 ) ; Appendix A describes the database, and Table A1 summarizes both cohorts.
We use 1,132 scan pairs from 952 subjects. Each pair has a T1-weighted MRI, an amyloid PET scan and a plasma sample, with
MRI and plasma taken within 90 days of the PET scan. Three tracers are used:
florbetapir, florbetaben and NAV4694. The plasma panel comes from the University of Pennsylvania ADNI plasma study and has nine measurements. Fujirebio Lumipulse provides p-tau217,
A β \beta 42, A β \beta 40, A β \beta 42/40, p-tau217/A β \beta 42, NfL and GFAP; Quanterix
Simoa provides a second NfL and GFAP ( Palmqvist et al., 2025 ; Rissin et al., 2010 ) . Every pair has p-tau217, but only
about a third have all nine measurements. We split the pairs by subject into
training, validation and test sets.

blocks.en:
The second cohort combines the A4 study and its companion LEARN study ( Sperling et al., 2014 ; Sperling et al., 2020 ) .
It differs from ADNI in two ways. First, its participants were cognitively unimpaired
at enrollment. Second, its plasma was measured on other platforms: p-tau217 by Eli
Lilly, and A β \beta 42, A β \beta 40, NfL and GFAP by Roche Elecsys at screening only.
The two Lumipulse NfL and GFAP inputs are never available, and most pairs have
p-tau217 alone. MRI and plasma are taken within 90 days of the PET scan, and the plasma sample is also within 90 days of the MRI. The Roche markers are therefore available only for screening PET scans. Of the 1,645 florbetapir pairs that pass quality control (Appendix A ), we use the 1,473 with a p-tau217 measurement, from 1,006 subjects, and split them by subject into training, validation and test sets. The plasma statistics,
regional regressions and texture template are fitted again on this training set;
nothing is carried over from ADNI.

blocks.en:
Both cohorts use the same registration and segmentation. Each pair is registered to the Montreal Neurological Institute (MNI152) space at
1.5 mm resolution ( 128 × 152 × 128 128\times 152\times 128 voxels), and SynthSeg ( Billot et al., 2023a ; Billot et al., 2023b ) segments
the MRI (Appendix A ). A4/LEARN PET scans are normalized to the cerebellar gray matter (SUVR). ADNI PET scans are distributed intensity-standardized and smoothed to a uniform 6 mm resolution, and we keep this intensity scale. On ADNI, amyloid status is the official status of the UC Berkeley
amyloid PET analysis, which uses tracer-specific thresholds ( Landau et al., 2012 ) . On our
SUVR scale, the cortical threshold that best reproduces this status on the training
set is 1.29. We use it to read synthesized scans, and to label the few scans without
an official status (mostly NAV4694). On A4/LEARN, a scan is amyloid-positive when its
true cortical SUVR exceeds 1.32, the threshold that best separates A4 screening scans
from LEARN scans, which were enrolled as amyloid-negative (Appendix A ).

We compare with four published synthesis models. Three use MRI only: PASTA, a

blocks.en:
We evaluate each synthesized scan at three levels. Image quality is measured by
PSNR and SSIM inside the brain mask, in SUVR units. Regional amyloid burden is the mean SUVR in the cortex and in the hippocampus, and in three further regions from the amyloid literature. Its agreement with the true scan is
the Spearman rank correlation across test scans, which shows whether a model orders the scans correctly. For amyloid status, the predicted cortical SUVR serves as
a score for the AUC, with DeLong confidence intervals ( DeLong et al., 1988 ) . We also report sensitivity and specificity at the reading threshold of each cohort, the way a real scan would be read. Differences between models are tested with a
paired bootstrap over test subjects (4,000 resamples). Every model is evaluated at the checkpoint chosen on validation.

regional pattern: it raises the hippocampal correlation by 0.26 on ADNI and 0.31 on

cortical correlation from 0.56 to 0.67, while on A4/LEARN the prior already ranks
cortical burden as well as the full model.

The MRI input matters least. Without it, the network sees the anatomy only through
the prior, which is painted on the subject’s own segmentation. It still keeps most

MRI input adds the rest, and it improves the hippocampal correlation on ADNI but not
on A4/LEARN. It has no significant effect on cortical
burden or AUC in either cohort. These results match the division of labor
behind the design: plasma sets the amyloid level, the subject’s anatomy shapes the
image, and the MRI intensities add a small refinement.

differ. We therefore refit only the SUVR prior on the A4/LEARN training set: the
plasma statistics, the regional regressions and the texture template. These are
closed-form steps that take minutes and need no network training. The network
trained on ADNI is kept frozen. Table 3 compares this setting with
the prior alone and with a model retrained on A4/LEARN.

from those of the retrained model (Table 3 ). The frozen network
also keeps most of its benefit for image quality over the prior alone. The remaining
gap lies in image detail: the retrained model is better by 1.6 dB in PSNR ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ) and in the hippocampal correlation ( p < 0.05 p<0.05 ). Part of this gap may reflect resolution: the frozen network was trained on ADNI images smoothed to 6 mm, and the A4/LEARN scans are not smoothed. A new
cohort can thus be served by refitting the prior alone, and retraining the network
improves the image further.

A real amyloid PET scan is read by comparing its SUVR with a fixed threshold. A
synthesized scan can be read the same way only if two conditions hold: its values
must be in absolute SUVR, and they must differ between subjects as the true values
do. Figure 4 shows that the published models fail the
second condition. Three of them predict nearly the same cortical SUVR for every
subject, with a standard deviation of 0.06 to 0.13 on ADNI against a true 0.24.
IL-CLDM varies more, but largely independently of the true burden. As a result,
their decisions are close to chance. On A4/LEARN, all four call almost every subject
positive (specificity at most 0.14), and on ADNI, CoCoLIT calls almost every subject
negative (sensitivity 0.02). Our predictions instead follow the true burden, with AUCs of 0.91 on ADNI and 0.82 on A4/LEARN, and can be read against a threshold, provided that it is calibrated on data from the same cohort (Appendix D ).

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en:
Our results show that a synthesized amyloid PET scan can carry subject-specific
amyloid information when the synthesis uses a blood test. The published models
reproduce the appearance of an amyloid PET scan, but they barely track cortical
amyloid burden, and they separate amyloid-positive from amyloid-negative subjects
poorly. This holds for the three models that see only the MRI,
and also for Plasma-CycleGAN, which uses plasma A β \beta 42/40. In our model, the ablations locate
the source of the amyloid information. Without plasma, image quality stays almost
the same, but the cortical correlation falls to less than half of its value in
both cohorts.
The regression analysis agrees: p-tau217 explains almost all of the cortical SUVR
that the plasma panel can explain, while plasma explains little of the hippocampal
SUVR, whose pattern comes from the images.
blocks.zh:
我们的结果显示,合成的酰胺PET扫描可以携带特定主题
合成使用血液测试时的酰胺信息. 公布的模式
复制Amyloid PET扫描的外观 但它们几乎无法跟踪皮质
甲酰基负载,它们将甲酰基抗体与甲酰基负体分离。

也用于Plasma-CycleGAN,它使用血浆A β\β 42/40. 在我们的模型中,爆炸地点
该类酰胺信息的来源。 没有等离子体,图像质量几乎保持不变
但皮质相关性下降到不到其价值的一半

blocks.en:
The ablations support the division of labor behind the design. Plasma sets the
amyloid level, the refinement network turns the prior into a realistic image, and
the subject’s anatomy places the amyloid on the right structures. Most of this
anatomical information already reaches the network through the prior, which is
painted on the subject’s own segmentation. The MRI intensities add a smaller
refinement: about 0.6 dB on ADNI and 0.2 dB on A4/LEARN, and a better hippocampal
pattern on ADNI. A practical consequence is that the two inputs complement each other. A blood test indicates the amyloid level of a subject but gives no image, and an MRI scan gives a realistic image but says little about the amyloid level. The synthesis combines both.
blocks.zh:
浮雕支持设计背后的分工. 等离子体设置
酰胺水平,精细网络将前一个转化为现实的图像,以及
解剖学将氨基放在正确的结构上。 大部分都是这样
解剖学信息已经通过前一个系统到达网络,即

改进:ADNI上约0.6 dB,A4/LEARN上约0.2 dB,以及更好的河马群
ADNI的图案。 一个实际结果是,这两项投入相辅相成。 血液测试显示一个对象的酰胺水平,但没有给出图像,核磁共振扫描给出了一个现实的图像,但对酰胺水平却说得很少. 合成两者结合.

blocks.en:
The synthesized scans also carry amyloid information beyond the cortical average. In both
cohorts, SUPRA follows the true burden across subjects in the composite cortex and the
early-accumulation region, and to a lesser degree in the striatum, whereas the published
models barely do (Table 2 ). The early-accumulation region and the striatum
matter because amyloid pathology is staged by the order in which it reaches brain
regions ( Thal et al., 2002 ; Grothe et al., 2017 ; Mattsson et al., 2019 ; Hanseeuw et al., 2018 ) . A synthesized scan thus adds
to the blood test an estimate in absolute SUVR for each region.
blocks.zh:
合成扫描还携带超过皮层平均值的酰胺信息. 两者
组群, SUPRA 跟踪复合皮层和
早期积累地区,在较轻的程度上在结构中,而出版的
模型几乎无法做到(表2)。 早期的积累区和结构
物质,因为酰胺病理 由它到达大脑的顺序进行
(Thal等人,2002年;Grothe等人,2017年;Mattsson等人,2019年;Hanseew等人,2018年) 合成扫描结果添加
在血液测试中,每个区域的绝对SUVR估计数。

blocks.en:
Because the output is in absolute SUVR, a synthesized scan can be read like a real
one, against a positivity threshold. On ADNI, this already gives a balanced
decision. Our predictions are, however, pulled toward the cohort mean, most clearly
on A4/LEARN, where amyloid-negative subjects are predicted slightly too high and the specificity drops (Table D4 ). A threshold recalibrated on validation data from the same
cohort restores a more useful balance. Any use of synthesized scans for decisions should therefore include a calibration step for the target cohort. Such a calibration needs a reference sample with true PET from the target population, so a threshold that holds across populations remains an open problem. Synthesized scans are
not a replacement for amyloid PET. They could, however, provide regional amyloid
estimates where PET is not available, for example in large cohorts that collect MRI and blood samples but no amyloid PET. These uses
would need prospective evaluation.
blocks.zh:
由于输出是绝对的SUVR,合成的扫描可以读作真实的
一,对一个假设阈值。 关于ADNI,这已经给了一个平衡的
决定。 然而,我们的预测被拉向 组别,最明显的是
在A4/LEARN中,对氨基阴性主体的预测略过高,特异性下降(表D4)。 在相同的验证数据上重新调整的阈值
组组恢复更有用的平衡 。 因此,对决策的综合扫描的任何使用都应包括针对目标群体的校准步骤。 这种校准需要从目标人群中找到一个真实的PET的参考样本,因此在人群中维持一个阈值仍然是一个尚未解决的问题。 合成扫描
而不是替代酰胺PET。 但是,它们可以提供区域酰胺。
例如,在收集核磁共振和血液样本但无氨基聚氨酯PET的大批人群中。 这些用途
需要未来的评估。

blocks.en:
Image-similarity metrics alone can be misleading for amyloid PET synthesis. In our
comparison, the published models reach reasonable PSNR and SSIM values while their
cortical SUVR hardly follows the true burden (Table D3 ). Studies of
amyloid PET synthesis should therefore also report regional burden agreement and
amyloid status, in absolute SUVR units.
blocks.zh:
光是图像-同质性度量就可能对酰胺PET合成产生误导. 在我们
比较后,公布的模型达到合理的PSNR值和SSIM值,而其数值为:
皮质的SUVR几乎跟不上真正的负担(表D3)。 学习
因此,聚氨酯PET合成还应报告区域负担协议和
氨基状态,以绝对SUVR单位表示.

blocks.en: We evaluated the method in two cohorts that differ in cognitive profile and plasma assay platforms, and we tested transfer between them by refitting only the prior. The architecture is transparent, and the ablations locate the contribution of each input. The method performs better than four published synthesis models in both cohorts.
blocks.zh: 我们在认知剖面和等离子体测定平台上 评估了两种组别的方法, 我们测试了它们之间的转移, 仅用前一种。 架构是透明的,拼贴物定位每个输入的贡献. 该方法在两个组中的表现都优于四个已公布的合成模型.

blocks.en:
Our study has several limitations. Both cohorts are research cohorts with selected
participants, and the A4/LEARN participants were cognitively unimpaired. The
performance in memory-clinic populations remains to be tested. Our predictions are
compressed toward the cohort mean, so high burden tends to be underestimated and low
burden overestimated. The comparison methods were trained with their published recipes and
not tuned further; tuning might improve their image quality.
blocks.zh:
我们的研究有几个局限性。 两个组都是研究组,有选择
A4/LEARN的参与者在认知上不受阻碍。 那个
记忆-临床人群中的表现仍有待测试。 我们的预测是
压在人群身上意味着 如此沉重的负担 往往被低估和降低
负担高估。 比较方法以其公布的食谱和
不进一步调试;调试可能会提高它们的图像质量.

blocks.en:
Several extensions follow naturally. The same design could be applied to tau PET,
where plasma p-tau217 may also be informative, and to longitudinal data, to synthesize
changes in amyloid burden over time. A per-subject uncertainty estimate would help users decide when a synthesized scan can be trusted. Further work could test the method in cohorts earlier in the disease course and examine whether synthesized scans help predict cognitive decline. Finally, evaluation in
clinical cohorts with routine MRI and clinical plasma assays would show how well the
method works outside research studies.
blocks.zh:
几个扩展自然地随之而来。 同样的设计可以适用于Tau PET,
其中等离子体p-tau217也可能是信息化的,并用于纵向数据,以合成
氨基气压随时间变化。 每个主体的不确定性估计将有助于用户决定何时可以信任一个合成扫描. 进一步的工作可以在疾病课程早期的人群中测试这种方法,并检查综合扫描是否有助于预测认知下降。 最后,评价
具有常规核磁共振和临床等离子体检测的临床组群将显示:
方法在研究之外起作用。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
We presented SUPRA, a method that synthesizes amyloid PET from structural MRI and
plasma biomarkers. It turns the plasma panel into an explicit regional SUVR prior,
painted on the subject’s own anatomy, and refines this prior with an anatomy-guided
residual network. The output is in absolute SUVR, and the model accepts incomplete
plasma panels, down to p-tau217 alone. On ADNI and on the second cohort, A4/LEARN,
the synthesized scans reach higher image quality than the published synthesis models, and they track the true amyloid burden across brain regions and separate amyloid-positive from amyloid-negative subjects far better. Our ablations show that the amyloid information comes from plasma,
while the subject’s anatomy shapes the image. In our experiments, removing the blood test removed most of the amyloid information. Combining the two inputs gives images that are realistic and carry subject-specific amyloid information in each region, which a single blood value cannot show.

等离子体生物标志. 它把等离子板变成一个明显的区域SUVR前,
并用解剖学指南加以改进
残网. 输出为绝对 SUVR, 模型接受不完整

blocks.en: The A4 Study was a secondary prevention trial in preclinical Alzheimer’s disease, aiming to slow cognitive decline associated with brain amyloid accumulation in clinically normal older individuals. The A4 and LEARN Studies were led by Dr. Reisa Sperling at Brigham and Women’s Hospital, Harvard Medical School, and Dr. Paul Aisen at the Alzheimer’s Therapeutic Research Institute (ATRI) at the University of Southern California. blocks.en: We set the thresholds from the data. On the ADNI training set, the cortical SUVR that best reproduces the official status is 1.29, with an agreement of 93% (1.26 for florbetapir and 1.29 for florbetaben alone). On A4/LEARN, true cortical SUVR separates A4 screening scans from LEARN scans with an AUC of 0.93, and the best cut is 1.32. The threshold of 1.11 often used for florbetapir with a whole-cerebellum reference ( Landau et al., 2012 ) does not fit our SUVR scale: on A4/LEARN it labels 90% of LEARN scans positive, although LEARN enrolled amyloid-negative participants, and on the ADNI training set it agrees with the official UC Berkeley status for only 66% of scans.

First, PSNR and SSIM over the whole volume are higher than inside the brain mask for all models, because the background is easy to predict; the exception is the PSNR of Plasma-CycleGAN. Our
model remains best on both versions of each metric, in both cohorts.

模式在两种计量标准中都是最好的。

blocks.en:
Second, the cortical SUVR of the published models hardly follows the true burden. Their slopes lie between − 0.02 -0.02 and 0.08, except for IL-CLDM on ADNI (0.33). PASTA, CoCoLIT and Plasma-CycleGAN also vary little between subjects (SD ratios of 0.25 to 0.53), while IL-CLDM varies more (0.85 and 1.17). Our predictions follow the
true values, with a slope of 0.57 on ADNI and 0.28 on A4/LEARN and a mean bias of at
most 0.03 SUVR. They are still pulled toward the cohort mean, most clearly on
A4/LEARN, where the SD ratio is 0.54.
blocks.zh:
其次,已公布模型的皮质SUVR几乎不遵循真正的负担. 它们的坡度在−0.02-0.02和0.08之间,但ADNI上的IL-CLDM(0.33)除外. PASTA、CoCoLIT和Plasma-CycleGAN在学科之间也差异不大(SD比为0.25比0.53),而IL-CLDM差异更大(0.85和1.17)。 我们的预测跟随
实际值,ADNI的坡度为0.57,A4/LEARN的坡度为0.28,平均偏差为
大多数0.03 SUVR。 他们仍然被拉向 群凶,最明显
A4/LEARN,其中SD比为0.54.
